model.quantization: ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION with NVFP4 target expert layers 3-44 and MXFP8 MTP expert layer 45

runtime.image_policy: Use one immutable derived image ID on all ranks. Record the immutable parent image ID in org.sparkcache.parent-image-id. The image must pass the required-label, source-tree, model, NCCL, and in-container vLLM lease-contract attestation in the runtime profile.

evidence.conditions: The cache-disabled runtime template preserves the target, BF16 DFlash2, TP4/DCP1, scheduler, graph, native prefix-cache, chunked-prefill, asynchronous scheduling, and patched-NCCL settings used by the qualified SparkCache composition, while omitting only the external key-value connector.
evidence.measurement: CPU-only contract tests validate the recipe, sanitized site template, runtime profile, immutable pins, required image labels, in-container source attestation command, and resolved four-rank launch plan.
evidence.result: The public profile can produce a fail-closed four-rank plan with SparkCache disabled. No standalone live cache-disabled receipt for this exact public BF16 DFlash2 image composition is recorded.
evidence.conclusion: The cache-disabled profile is implemented and suitable as a controlled comparison configuration after operators supply and verify one immutable image ID on every rank.
limitations: A live cache-disabled startup, semantic gate, soak, and throughput measurement are not recorded for this exact public profile.
The target repository does not identify its base-checkpoint revision.
The qualified NCCL binary is identified by SHA-256 but not by a complete source-commit and build receipt.
The public template does not name a published serving-image manifest because none was recorded by the qualification.
